name: net_turn_out_of_reach
description: A TURN numbered far past anything a server sends (more than an hour of turns beyond the turns complete; here 80,000 turns, so even a game without the bound only grows its log a little) is refused: the client fails its link with the reason instead of growing its turn log toward the number; a repeat of an old turn is still taken quietly. A chain of TURNs each within an hour of the highest seen walks no further (review M1 protocol 2): the reach is measured from the turns complete.

steps.msg: a repeated old turn is taken quietly

steps.assert: scene.client(1).phase_name() == 'FAILED' and scene.client(1).error_text.begins_with('The server sent turn ') and scene.client(1).error_text.ends_with(', out of reach')
steps.msg: a turn out of reach fails the link with the reason
and the turn log never grew toward it
a turn within an hour of the turns complete is taken (its gap is asked for)

steps.assert: scene.client(2).phase_name() == 'FAILED' and scene.client(2).error_text.ends_with(', out of reach')
steps.msg: the next link of a chain, within an hour of the highest seen but not of the turns complete, fails the link
and the log never grew past the first link
